title: GD Goenka University recorded a 31 October 2026 scholarship-form deadline for current applicants
description: Review the 31 October 2026 scholarship evidence deadline at GD Goenka University and compare Haryana’s three ICAR-listed agriculture universities.
summary: GD Goenka University’s scholarship policy page recorded 31 October 2026 as the deadline for submitting scholarship forms and supporting evidence, underscoring the need to separate fee-waiver deadlines from general admission dates across Haryana universities.

sections.heading: What the 31 October 2026 GD Goenka deadline covers
paragraphs: [GD Goenka University](/university/gd-goenka-university) in Sohna (Gurugram) recorded 31 October 2026 on its public scholarship schedule as the deadline for submitting completed scholarship forms and supporting documentary evidence.

This date applies specifically to scholarship consideration rather than establishing an open general-admission window. Applicants should always obtain written confirmation of whether a merit or sports concession applies to B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture.

sections.heading: Comparing SGT University, GD Goenka University and MM(DU) Mullana
paragraphs: Haryana’s researched collection includes two NCR campuses in Gurugram—[SGT University](/university/sgt-university) and [GD Goenka University](/university/gd-goenka-university)—alongside [Maharishi Markandeshwar (Deemed to be University), Mullana](/university/maharishi-markandeshwar-mullana) in Ambala district.

Before choosing between an NCR commuter campus and a residential campus in Ambala, read [check agriculture scholarship conditions before budgeting](/blogs/agriculture-scholarship-conditions) and [compare two agriculture campuses](/blogs/compare-agriculture-campuses).

faqs.question: Does the 31 October 2026 date at GD Goenka University confirm open B.Sc. Agriculture seats?
faqs.answer: No. That date was published for scholarship-form and supporting-evidence submission. Check the admissions office directly for intake status.

faqs.question: Are first-year merit scholarships automatically renewed for all four years of B.Sc. Agriculture?
faqs.answer: No. Continuation usually requires maintaining a specified CGPA, attendance and discipline record each academic year.
